settings.name: USE_BLACKLIST
settings.description: **Enable Blacklist:** Set to `yes` to enable the blacklist feature.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_COMMUNITY_LISTS
settings.description: **Community Blacklists:** Select pre-configured community-maintained blacklists to include in blocking.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IP
settings.description: **IP Blacklist:** List of IP addresses or networks (CIDR notation) to block, separated by spaces.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_IP
settings.description: **IP Ignore List:** List of IP addresses or networks that should bypass IP blacklist checks.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IP_URLS
settings.description: **IP Blacklist URLs:** List of URLs containing IP addresses or networks to block, separated by spaces.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_IP_URLS
settings.description: **IP Ignore List URLs:** List of URLs containing IP addresses or networks to ignore.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_RDNS
settings.description: **rDNS Blacklist:** List of reverse DNS suffixes to block, separated by spaces.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_RDNS_GLOBAL
settings.description: **rDNS Global Only:** Only perform rDNS checks on global IP addresses when set to `yes`.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_RDNS
settings.description: **rDNS Ignore List:** List of reverse DNS suffixes that should bypass rDNS blacklist checks.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_RDNS_URLS
settings.description: **rDNS Blacklist URLs:** List of URLs containing reverse DNS suffixes to block, separated by spaces.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_RDNS_URLS
settings.description: **rDNS Ignore List URLs:** List of URLs containing reverse DNS suffixes to ignore.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_ASN
settings.description: **ASN Blacklist:** List of Autonomous System Numbers to block, separated by spaces.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_ASN
settings.description: **ASN Ignore List:** List of ASNs that should bypass ASN blacklist checks.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_ASN_URLS
settings.description: **ASN Blacklist URLs:** List of URLs containing ASNs to block, separated by spaces.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_ASN_URLS
settings.description: **ASN Ignore List URLs:** List of URLs containing ASNs to ignore.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_USER_AGENT
settings.description: **User-Agent Blacklist:** List of User-Agent patterns (PCRE regex) to block, separated by spaces.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_USER_AGENT
settings.description: **User-Agent Ignore List:** List of User-Agent patterns that should bypass User-Agent blacklist checks.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_USER_AGENT_URLS
settings.description: **User-Agent Blacklist URLs:** List of URLs containing User-Agent patterns to block.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_USER_AGENT_URLS
settings.description: **User-Agent Ignore List URLs:** List of URLs containing User-Agent patterns to ignore.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_URI
settings.description: **URI Blacklist:** List of URI patterns (PCRE regex) to block, separated by spaces.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_URI
settings.description: **URI Ignore List:** List of URI patterns that should bypass URI blacklist checks.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_URI_URLS
settings.description: **URI Blacklist URLs:** List of URLs containing URI patterns to block, separated by spaces.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_URI_URLS
settings.description: **URI Ignore List URLs:** List of URLs containing URI patterns to ignore.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_HEADER_NAME
settings.description: **Header name:** Name of a request header that makes the request be blacklisted. Numbered pairs: `_NAME_1` goes with `_VALUE_1`.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_HEADER_VALUE
settings.description: **Header value:** PCRE regex the header value must match. Leave empty to match on the header being present, whatever it carries.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_HEADER_NAME
settings.description: **Header name:** Name of a request header that makes the request bypass the blacklist. Numbered pairs: `_NAME_1` goes with `_VALUE_1`.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_IGNORE_HEADER_VALUE
settings.description: **Header value:** PCRE regex the header value must match. Leave empty to match on the header being present, whatever it carries.
